title: X4 integration harness environment, fixture and evidence are unspecified
source: WP B-ITG-W4-06; legacy RWB-E7-004; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 INT-31 (line 240)
description: The sources do not specify the X4 harness environment or base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic case, deviation and referral keys, the Aric referral answer shape and status vocabulary, the investigation tracking evidence, the evidence format and retention, or the pass or fail gate.
evidence: No source line names a harness environment, a base host, a fixture layout, a referral answer shape or a report gate. INT-31 (line 240) gives the Aric fraud referral as 'Not available today; by the fraud investigator' and publishes no operation, payload or status value.
proposed: Agree the environment, base hosts, fixture layout, synthetic keys, referral fixture shape and status words, evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave 4 entry check, and hold them as harness configuration rather than business values in code.
